comment.en: On a single run: security 215 of 250, architecture 156 of 200, bugs 147 of 150, performance 128 of 150 and 71 of 100 in clean code, with no penalty. comment.en: Two runs, 64 points apart (886 and 822), with the same shape: 229 to 246 of 250 in security, 144 to 164 of 200 in architecture, 139 to 147 of 150 in bugs, 134 to 144 of 150 in performance and 64 to 71 of 100 in clean code. Both took the same 30-point compatibility deduction (COMP-003): the idempotency fingerprint now includes the user, so a repeated key from another user of the same company no longer returns the original response, which the manifest requires. The second run cost US$ 6.77 in 48 minutes of work, against US$ 13.03 in 82 for the first. Two runs of three: not official, and the published score is the lower of the two.

comment.en: On a single run: security 77 of 250, bugs 11 of 150, performance 51 of 150, architecture 22 of 200 and nothing in clean code, with the contract untouched (compatibility 100) and no penalty. It made a few small, targeted edits and fixed 7 of the 36 planted flaws; it reported 8 of them (one of those left unfixed) and one false positive, a counting bug the code does not have. The report was rated 30 of 50, weakest on prioritisation and trade-offs: its two critical findings come 7th and 8th in the list, and its table of decisions rarely compares alternatives. MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed is the M2.7 series served faster (MiniMax: "same performance, faster"), and OpenCode offers no effort setting for it. The agent wrote RELATORIO.md and achados.json inside code/ instead of the project root, and the delivery was accepted as made. Both stages ran in one OpenCode session of 10 minutes, without the 7 minutes the operator took between the two stages, through MiniMax's own API, for US$ 0.35. One run of three: it is not official and could move.

O MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed é a série M2.7 servida mais rápido (a MiniMax diz "mesmo desempenho, mais rápido"), e o OpenCode não oferece ajuste de esforço para ele. comment.en: On a single run: security 85 of 250, bugs 8 of 150, and nothing in architecture, performance or clean code, with compatibility at 75 of 100 for one violation kept as judged: the login rate limiter it added answers 401 even to the right password after five attempts in 15 minutes from the same non-local address (COMP-008). It fixed 3 of the 36 planted flaws and reported 5 (two of those left unfixed), with one false positive, a counting bug the code does not have, and one extra finding. The report was rated 34 of 50, weakest on precision, because it contradicts itself in places (a token valid "until expiry" and then "indefinitely") and overstates how long a brute-force attack would take. MiniMax-M2.7 is the standard-speed model of the series, and OpenCode offers no effort setting for it. Both stages ran in one OpenCode session of 15 minutes, without the 7 minutes the operator took between the two stages, through MiniMax's own API, for US$ 0.44. One run of three: it is not official and could move.

Corrigiu 3 das 36 falhas plantadas e reportou 5 (duas delas ficaram sem correção), com um falso positivo, um erro de contagem que o código não tem, e um achado extra. O relatório teve 34 de 50, com a nota mais baixa em precisão, porque se contradiz em alguns pontos (um token válido "até a expiração" e depois "indefinidamente") e exagera o tempo que um ataque de força bruta levaria. O MiniMax-M2.7 é o modelo de velocidade padrão da série, e o OpenCode não oferece ajuste de esforço para ele. As duas etapas rodaram em uma sessão do OpenCode de 15 minutos, sem os 7 minutos que o operador levou entre as duas etapas, pela API da própria MiniMax, por US$ 0,44.
